words.definition: The smallest unit of an element that retains that element's chemical properties.
Two or more atoms held together by chemical bonds.
A pure substance made of only one kind of atom.
A substance made of two or more different elements chemically bonded in fixed proportions.
Two or more substances combined without being chemically bonded to each other.
A mixture in which one substance is dissolved evenly in another.
The amount of mass in a given volume.
words.explanation: Density is calculated by dividing mass by volume.

words.definition: A measure of the amount of matter in an object.
The amount of space occupied by an object or substance.
The attractive force between objects that have mass.
A force that resists motion between surfaces touching each other.
The tendency of an object to resist a change in its motion.
The speed of an object together with its direction of motion.
The rate at which an object's velocity changes.
The ability to do work or cause change.
The transfer of thermal energy through direct contact between particles.
The transfer of thermal energy by the movement of a liquid or gas.
The transfer of energy by electromagnetic waves.
The change from a liquid to a gas at the liquid's surface.
The change from a gas to a liquid.
Water falling from clouds as rain, snow, sleet or hail.
The movement of weathered rock and soil by water, wind, ice or gravity.
The breaking down of rock at or near Earth's surface.
The dropping or settling of sediment carried by wind, water or ice.
The place where an organism lives.
A community of living organisms interacting with each other and their physical surroundings.
An organism that makes its own food, usually using sunlight.
An organism that gets energy by eating other organisms.
An organism that breaks down dead material and returns nutrients to the environment.
An inherited characteristic that helps an organism survive and reproduce in its environment.
